# antigravity-priority v1.3.9

## 更新内容 / Release Notes

### 中文

**v1.3.9 将配额调度收敛为 Gemini 与 Claude & GPT 双池架构，并强化 Prompt Guard 的二分排查指引。**

#### ♻️ 双配额池架构
- 移除独立的 Argon 配额池：Gemini 4 Argon 等模型统一归入 Gemini 池，调度、探测、状态缓存、预热与路由看板共用同一套 Gemini 5h/7d 窗口。
- 配额解析不再单独拆分 Argon 周桶，改由 Gemini 池按保守窗口统一评估；含 `argon` 的模型标识与配额分组统一映射到 Gemini 池。
- 配置中心移除 Argon 预热开关与目标模型选择，仅保留 Gemini、Claude & GPT 两个池的配置与可视化项；旧配置中的 `argon_enabled` / `argon_model` 字段在加载时被忽略，无需手动清理。
- 状态、投影、审计与诊断记录同步移除 Argon 专属窗口字段，历史 Argon 条目不再参与调度与展示。

#### 🛡️ Prompt Guard 排查指引
- 二分排查提示词新增请求超时建议：将超时设为 10 秒，flash-lite 正常约 3 秒回复，命中风控时上游会反复重试并超过 30 秒才返回 429，因此 10 秒无响应即可直接判定为 429，无需继续等待。

#### ⚙️ 工程与测试
- 配置、解析、状态、投影、预热与管理端测试全面对齐双池架构，移除 Argon 专属用例并补充模型归组覆盖。
- 版本元数据同步至 v1.3.9。

### English

**v1.3.9 consolidates quota scheduling into the Gemini and Claude & GPT two-pool architecture and strengthens Prompt Guard's binary-search guidance.**

#### ♻️ Two-Pool Architecture
- Removes the standalone Argon quota pool: models such as Gemini 4 Argon now belong to the Gemini pool, sharing the same Gemini 5h/7d windows for scheduling, probing, state caching, warm-up, and the routing board.
- Quota parsing no longer splits out a separate Argon weekly bucket; the Gemini pool evaluates all of its windows collectively with the conservative rule, and any `argon` model identifier or quota group maps to the Gemini pool.
- The Config Center drops the Argon warm-up toggle and target-model selector, keeping configuration and visualization only for the Gemini and Claude & GPT pools; legacy `argon_enabled` / `argon_model` fields are ignored on load and need no manual cleanup.
- State, projection, audit, and diagnostics records drop the Argon-specific window fields, and historical Argon entries no longer participate in scheduling or display.

#### 🛡️ Prompt Guard Guidance
- The binary-search prompt now recommends a 10-second request timeout: flash-lite normally replies in about 3 seconds, while a throttled upstream retries and emits 429 only after 30 seconds or more, so 10 seconds without a response can be treated as a 429 instead of waiting.

#### ⚙️ Engineering & Tests
- Aligns configuration, parsing, state, projection, warm-up, and management tests with the two-pool architecture, removing Argon-specific cases and covering model classification.
- Version metadata synchronized to v1.3.9.
